name: ai2ide
description: Use JetBrains IDE semantic capabilities from Codex through official MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Use JetBrains IDE semantics while coding in Codex.
interface.longDescription: ai2ide teaches Codex when to combine normal CLI workflows with JetBrains official MCP tools for symbol context, IDE inspections, build feedback, formatting, and high-trust IDE-assisted changes. It does not automate the IDE user interface or ship a custom JetBrains plugin in v1.
defaultPrompt: Use ai2ide to inspect and safely modify this project.
Use JetBrains MCP semantics before changing this API.
Diagnose this coding issue with CLI and IDE checks.
